title: Make sequences from iterate, generate and a closed range

blocks.text: Streams do not need a collection behind them. `Stream.iterate(seed, hasNext, next)` (Java 9) runs like a `for` loop and stops by itself; `Stream.generate(supplier)` is endless and needs a `limit()`; `IntStream.range(a, b)` excludes `b` while `IntStream.rangeClosed(a, b)` includes it.

items: `powersBelow(int bound)` returns the powers of two 1, 2, 4, ... that are **less than** `bound` (the three-argument `Stream.iterate` fits; `bound` is at most `1 << 20`).
`repeated(String text, int times)` returns `text` repeated `times` times (`Stream.generate` with a `limit` fits; `times` is never negative).
`labels(String prefix, int count)` returns `prefix + 1`, `prefix + 2`, ... up to `prefix + count`.

blocks.text: Mind which end of each sequence is included.

cases.says: It makes the powers of two below a bound and the repeated text, and no labels for a count of 0.
A power equal to the bound is not below it, so the three-argument iterate stops before it.
The labels run from 1 to count inclusive, as IntStream.rangeClosed does; range would drop the last one.

concepts: IntStream.range excludes its end, and IntStream.rangeClosed includes it.
